items.title: Adam and Eve
items.charge: Hearkening to the serpent’s doctrine, that ye shall not surely die; and eating the fruit of lies

items.title: Alexander the coppersmith
items.charge: Doing Paul much evil; greatly withstanding his words

items.title: Amalek
items.charge: Smiting the hindmost, the feeble and faint and weary, when Israel came out of Egypt; and he feared not God

items.title: Ananias the high priest
items.charge: Commanding Paul to be smitten on the mouth, contrary to the law, while sitting to judge him by the law

items.title: Babylon, the lady of kingdoms
items.charge: Shewing no mercy to the people the Lord was wroth with and gave into her hand; laying her yoke very heavily upon the ancient; saying in her heart, I am, and none else beside me; trusting in her wickedness, her wisdom, and the multitude of her sorceries

items.title: Cain
items.charge: Bringing of the fruit of the ground when the sacrificial law required a firstling; refusing correction; and murder of his brother Abel

items.title: Chorazin, Bethsaida, and Capernaum
items.charge: Not repenting after the mighty works done in them

items.title: Edom, in the day of his brother
items.charge: Standing on the other side in the day that strangers carried away Jacob captive, and being as one of them; rejoicing over the children of Judah in the day of their destruction; entering the gate, laying hands on the substance, standing in the crossway to cut off those that escaped, and delivering up those that remained

items.title: Esau
items.charge: Despising his birthright; marrying the daughters of Heth against the fathers’ law; purposing to kill his brother

items.title: Gehazi
items.charge: Running after Naaman to take what his master refused; lying to Naaman and then to the prophet’s face

items.title: Ham and the curse on Canaan
items.charge: Seeing the nakedness of his father and not covering him

items.title: Hiel the Bethelite
items.charge: Building Jericho again under the oath Joshua adjured before the Lord

items.title: Jehoiakim
items.charge: Building his house by unrighteousness and his chambers by wrong, using his neighbour’s service without wages; eyes and heart set on covetousness, innocent blood, oppression and violence; slaying Urijah the prophet; cutting the roll of the Lord’s words with a penknife and burning it

items.title: Jeroboam son of Nebat
items.charge: Two calves of gold, behold thy gods, O Israel; priests of the lowest of the people; a feast devised of his own heart

items.title: Judah robbing God in tithes and offerings
items.charge: Going away from the Lord’s ordinances and not keeping them; robbing God in tithes and offerings, so that there was no meat in His house and the Levites fled every one to his field

items.title: Michal
items.charge: Despising the king in her heart for dancing before the ark; how glorious was the king of Israel to day

items.title: Omri
items.charge: Doing worse than all that were before him; walking in all the way of Jeroboam

items.title: Reuben
items.charge: Lying with Bilhah, his father’s concubine

items.title: Saul and Doeg at Nob
items.charge: Slaughter of the priests of the Lord on an Edomite’s report

items.title: Shemaiah the Nehelamite
items.charge: Sending letters in his own name from Babylon to have Jeremiah put in prison and in the stocks as a madman; prophesying when the Lord sent him not, and causing the people to trust in a lie

items.title: Simeon and Levi at Shechem
items.charge: Deceitful covenant; slaughter of a city in their anger

items.title: The Gibeonites, and Israel’s oath
items.charge: Obtaining a covenant by fraud; and Israel making it without asking counsel at the mouth of the Lord

items.title: The priests who despised the Name
items.charge: Offering polluted bread upon the altar, and the blind, the lame, and the sick for sacrifice; saying the table of the Lord is contemptible and its service a weariness; departing out of the way, causing many to stumble at the law, and being partial in the law

items.title: The scribes and Pharisees
items.charge: Shutting up the kingdom against men; devouring widows’ houses; tithing mint and omitting judgment, mercy and faith; whited sepulchres

items.title: The shepherds of Israel
items.charge: Feeding themselves and not the flock; eating the fat and clothing themselves with the wool; not strengthening the diseased, healing the sick, binding up the broken, bringing again the driven away, or seeking the lost; ruling with force and with cruelty

items.title: They that troubled the churches with circumcision
items.charge: Preaching another gospel, subverting souls with a commandment the apostles never gave
